en_how: Three.js lays out a canyon street of procedurally sized towers whose window textures are drawn from a seed and re-mapped so windows never stretch, with original glowing signs painted as textures; a train crosses on an elevated rail; the whole city is duplicated upside-down below a translucent wet-asphalt ground (more transparent where puddles are), so signs reflect on the street; exponential fog and additive light-beam sprites give volume, the camera pushes slowly down the street, and Canvas adds a downsampled blurred bloom and slanting rain.
